en.t: For me to think such a thing was truly inauspicious.

units.source_text: 今后我力不从心、使尽千方百计不能与你相会之时，恐怕真会失恋而死呢！

en.t: From now on, when my strength fails me and I cannot meet you no matter what means I try, I fear I may truly die of a broken heart.

units.source_text: 当初你对我如此冷淡，其实我何必来寻找你，如今反而痛苦了。”

en.t: Since you were so cold to me at first, why did I ever come looking for you? Now it has only brought me pain."

units.source_text: 浮舟就用他那蘸了墨的笔写道：

en.t: Ukifune then took his ink-dipped brush and wrote:
